title: Consumer Product Safety Commission SWAT raid on United Nuclear

tellings.quote: raided by the Consumer Product Safety Commission. They come in with a SWAT team with a machine woke my wife up out of bed with, you know, an M-16 pointed in her face.

plain: Bob Lazar says that in the 2000s his company, United Nuclear, was raided by the Consumer Product Safety Commission, the federal agency that polices product safety, and that the agents came into his home with a SWAT team. He tells Michels they woke his wife in bed with an M-16 pointed at her face.
